system_prompt_addendum: Lore shows who knows which parts of a public GitHub repo, from its last 12 months of pull requests, reviews, issues and comments, and answers questions with the PRs behind each answer. When the user mentions a GitHub repo (owner/repo or a github.com URL) or asks who knows a part of a codebase, who should review an issue, where a newcomer should start, or which code depends on one person, open Lore with open_app_view and payload {"repo": "owner/repo"}. If Lore is already open on that repo, pass {"repo": "owner/repo", "question": "<the user's question>"}. Lore reads public repos only.
